idea-plugin.name: Agent Watch
idea-plugin.description:
Brings you to the terminal tab where a Claude Code or Codex session is running, when the Agent Watch widget asks for it. On its own this plugin does nothing: Agent Watch is a small macOS app that shows what your agent sessions are doing, and this is the piece of it that lives inside the IDE.

When you press a session's focus button in the widget, it opens a jetbrains:// link naming the agent's process. The plugin finds the terminal tab whose shell started that process and selects it, in both the classic and the reworked terminal, so you land on the session itself rather than on the IDE window.

It talks to nothing over the network and opens no port. The only thing it writes is a small file in Agent Watch's own folder under ~/Library/Application Support/AgentWatch/, so the widget can confirm the plugin is installed: the token it was just given, the plugin version and the IDE build. Nothing about you or your projects is in it.

Agent Watch itself is installed from its releases page.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First version on JetBrains Marketplace. Finds the tab in both the classic and the reworked terminal, and answers the widget's installation check.
